book.name: HEBREOS
book.title: HEBREOS Hebreonaan hat'ee hẽsap p'ã deepʌ̈itarr

content: Keena, hĩs hewag pawiajã, hich Hẽwandamauchata jaautarr haawai, hagt'a hi haar barju haai nʌm. Maguata maachjã k'ĩir k'ap'ʌ wënʌrraju haai nʌm, heeu hamjö hãb k'ãijã mag hirua maach k'ĩir meeupiju ha sim haar pöd barba haduk'am.

Hamag jaautarrjö maachigjã maach peerdʌajem hiek jaauwi nʌm. Mamʌ hamaun mag hamachig jaautarrjã sĩi par jʌ̃gʌupai hũrtarr haawai ham hat'ee chan bʌ̃ʌrjã serbiibajim haajem, hʌ̈u chi hʌ̈k'a narr k'ʌʌn dʌ̈i warag k'ĩirjug hãba ham dënjö hi hipierraa haba harr haawai.
Maach chi hʌ̈k'a nʌm k'ʌʌnan, mag Hẽwandamau maach hich haar p'ë hauwi hich dʌ̈i k'ĩir meeupiju ha sim haar barju.

content.text: Mamʌ hi hichaaur nʌm k'ʌʌn chan hichdëu ham k'ĩir meeupiju ha jaautarr durrjã barbamgui hajim. (Sal. 95:11)

content: Mag hamau hi hichaaur habamuan, hamjã dubk'am, ya Hẽwandamau mʌg durr hompaawaiwe mag hõor k'ĩir meeupiju durrjã sĩi wai sĩerr haawai.
Mag k'ĩir meeu nʌisiewai jua hʌ̃iju higwi, hĩchab hich Hẽwandam jua hʌ̃itarrjã jaauwi,

content.text: “Hẽwandamau nem t'ʌnʌm t'um seis días nʌm hee wau haaipapʌ̈iwi hag noram siete diam gaai hichjã jua hʌ̃ijim” ha sim, “hichdëu nem hig sĩerr t'um waubapäaiwai.” (Gn. 2:2)

content: Mag israelnaan k'ʌd jãrrpai k'ëchtarr k'ʌʌn higwiajã, hich Hẽwandamaucha,

content.text: hi hichaaur nʌm k'ʌʌn chan hich sim haig hich dʌ̈i jua hʌ̃imk'ĩir dubpibaju hajim hĩchab hich hag hiek gaaipai. (Sal. 95:11)

content: Magta nacha hi hiek hũrtarr k'ʌʌn hamach jʌ̃g t'eeg gaaimua dubbajierram haajem. Mamʌ hagt'a hewagam k'ʌʌn dubju waaur nʌm, hi hipierraa nʌm k'ʌʌn.
Mag hi hipierraa nʌm k'ʌʌn dubju haai nʌm higwi, Moisés meetarr k'ur nassi pawijã David k'ararrau Hẽwandam hiek p'ãawai,

content.text: “Hĩs pãachdëu Hẽwandam hiek jaau nʌm hũurwai hoob t'ãar t'eeg hamiet” ha p'ãjim. (Sal. 95:7-8)

content: Magua hichdëu jaau pʌatarrjö, hĩsweta hʌ̈k'aju haai nʌm, hagt'a hʌ̈k'aju haai nʌwe.

Mamʌ mag hirua hiek'aju nawe, chi Moisés meetarr k'ur Josueu israelnaan Canaan durr wai duubwaijã warre hich Hẽwandamau maach k'ĩir meeupiju ha sim haarchata wai dubtarr hamuan, Hẽwandamau hĩs hewagam k'ʌʌnagjã hich haar wëtju hayaa hamk'ĩir “Hĩsweta hʌ̈k'aju haai nʌm hagt'a hʌ̈k'aju haai nʌwe” habak'am.

Magua maadëu k'ap'ʌ nʌm, mag Hẽwandamau maach k'ĩir meeupiju ha sim chan mʌig heegarpai k'aba, ya mʌg hatag hich haarcha maach p'ë hat'aawai hich jãg hichjã mʌg durr t'um waupʌ̈iwi jua hʌ̃itarrjö jua hʌ̃i wënʌrrajuuta jaau sim.
Chi mam Hẽwandam sim haarta hʌ̈u barbaimam wounan, chadcha tag p'it'urgjã hauba, hich jãg mʌg durr hompaawi hich Hẽwandamjã jua hʌ̃itarrjö, hich mag hi jua hʌ̃i chitaju.
Maguata maachin Hẽwandam hiek jaau nʌm maachdëu hũrtarrta warag hogdʌba hʌ̈k'a nʌmua mag hi dʌ̈icha naaimajuuta hẽk'aju haai nʌm, ni hãbmuajã israelnaanau Hẽwandam hiek hʌ̈k'aba harrjö haba.

Mʌg Hẽwandam hiek'an hich mag chugpaa k'augba sĩerranaa nem jua t'eeg sĩerrʌm, hich Hẽwandam hiek haawai. Maguata t'ut'ui p'õpá garm magwe dee sim k'ãaijã nem degcha sĩewai maach pa hak'aar hoonaa maach hö hak'aarjã k'aug haaujem. Maach k'ĩirjugjã k'ogreu jʌrnaa dichdëu nem wauju dich t'ãar heepai wai sĩsidʌmjã k'aug haumaajem.

Mʌg t'ʌnʌm haig chan pöd hiwiir hãbmuajã Hẽwandam dau merpʌ̈iju k'aba sim. Hirigan nem t'ʌnʌm t'um hich dau haig haunaata hoo nʌmjö dawaa t'ʌnʌm. Hẽwandam mag maadëu nem wau nʌmjã t'umaa hoojem k'ĩirp'eeta maachin dʌnʌnʌid haimaju, maachdëu nem waaujerr t'umaa hirig meerba jawaag.
Hich Jesuuta maach kõit hiek'aajem chaark'a sĩsijim

Mamʌ hich jãg warrgar p'adnaan pöröu hõor kõit Hẽwandamag jëeujerrjö, hĩsjã hagjö maach kõit hiek'aajem chaar wai nʌm; hajapcharan hich Hẽwandam Hiewaama. Hichta mawi hʌ̃gt'ar sĩejem, mammua maach kõit hiek'aag. Maguata maachin maachdëu hi hiek hʌ̈k'a nʌmta warag hogdʌba hʌ̈k'anaa hag gaaita hubʌ wënʌrraju haai nʌm.

Mag hʌ̃gt'armua maach kõit hiek'aajemuan chadcha maach dau haug k'aaugjem. Hẽwandamta maach wounk'a sĩerr haawai hichdëujã k'ap'ʌ sim, jãga haajẽ maach pekau hee burrjöjöo haadëp'ʌm haig. Meperau maach pekau hee burrpiju hẽk'aajemjö haju hẽk'aajeejim hi dʌ̈ijã hagjö; mamʌ maagjerrta hich chan bʌ̃ʌrjã pekau hee burrba k'itajim.

Maach kõit hiek'aajemua mag maach dau haug k'aaugjem k'ap'ʌ naawai bʌ̃ʌrjã högk'aba warag Hẽwandam t'umaam k'ʌʌn Pörk'anaa t'umaam k'ʌʌn dʌ̈i hajap'a k'itʌmta jʌrju haai nʌm hirig jëeu nʌmua, pekau hee burrjöjöo haadëp'ʌm haig hi hiigwaijã hʌ̈u hirua maach dau haug k'augwi maach k'aigpërmk'ĩir.
